column1: # Android 6.0.1 drawables copied from the Nexus 5X image by docs/tools/mm-assets.py: <output>
# SystemUI navigation bar (navigation_bar.xml: KeyButtonView back / home / recent_apps, the menu and IME keys, lights out)
# framework Material Switch thumb (switch_thumb_material_anim: the off and on frames, tinted in CSS by multiply)
# framework Material RadioButton (btn_radio_material_anim: the off and on frames, tinted in CSS as SRC_IN)
# The default wallpaper (framework default_wallpaper, the Marshmallow beach) and the keyguard's bitmap icons
# framework GlobalActions: PowerAction's icon (ic_lock_power_off is a bitmap of this alpha mask tinted colorControlNormal)
# Google Now Launcher (Launcher3 and GEL in Velvet.apk): folder ring, all apps button, page indicator, the search bar
# SystemUI Overview (recents.xml scrims; the task header's dismiss buttons)
# Launcher3 overview panel buttons and the first-run cling
# The keyguard bouncer (keyguard_pin_view.xml): the enter key
# Settings > Users: a user row's manage button (preference_user_delete_widget: the divider, then ic_sysbar_quicksettings)
